body:
The v2 reducer is supported for its tested symbolic ledger contract, while the semantic judgments it consumes remain unqualified. This preparation freezes the next bounded screen: natural-language claim plus authorized BODY evidence → declared materiality, bindings, support relation, coverage and applicable decomposition guards.

Preparation state: **TERMINAL_PREPARATION_READY**. The experiment remains **designed / NOT_RUN**. No case author, adjudicator, semantic assessor, project generator or reducer was executed. No natural-language corpus or accepted labels exists yet.

## Context & Purpose

Preparation authority: #29. Qualified predecessor: #28, closed without merge. The reducer and all predecessor artifacts are unchanged. The [entrypoint](https://github.com/camerontjs-dot/biotech-rag-assistant/blob/6f6e90b75f160370116a22c1c342231d9d14008d/research/evidence/qualifier-grounding-semantic-assessor-controls-v1/README.md) links the rubric and protocols.

## Proposed Changes

- Freeze an operational rubric before case design, including scoped obligations, ENTAILED/CONTRADICTED/SILENT/AMBIGUOUS BODY relations, COMPLETE/UNKNOWN coverage, and six separately justified tri-state guards.
- Preregister 44 future packets: 28 anchors covering the 21 requested categories, three non-BODY authority controls, and four additional guard/uncertainty controls; eight invariance variants and eight material mutations yield 16 relations.
- Prepare six narrow launch packets. A/B receive no author hypotheses, family keys, desired outcomes or peer reasoning. Preserve raw judgments before explicit reconciliation; optional C is blind before attributed open adjudication.
- Freeze evaluator assurance, dimension-level scoring, safety vetoes and unresolved-denominator handling. Agreement alone cannot validate labels. Future corpus/label hashes remain null.
- Add six schemas, a physical structure/custody validator, adversarial/disconnection tests and a dedicated hosted preparation check. No semantic scorer, assessor or adjudicator launcher is implemented.

## Verification & Test Receipts

25 structural tests pass; new-source Ruff 0.16.5 passes the frozen repository rules; all six contract checks pass. The frozen check verifies 31 package artifact hashes, six launch packets and four predecessor identity hashes. Tests use uninterpreted tokens, not semantic control cases.

Rubric commit/tree: `e68ea36403c4c17c5b111e88ae1e5ca9031c1ca5` / `6edf340e5e5a1201d911502292c79663faa592f7`.
Rubric SHA-256: `11092f20ec28a1124b208f4eb09d43258c125fe4e57b94692613fa8ad009359d`.
Package commit/tree: `b817ef0b3c964a8f9e89170107d7b69fa90dd7a3` / `c109b41dd1b4708ca14dd474616f649583e1a22a`.
Manifest SHA-256: `9b20079779895255ee27fe9dda2899f0e0bda4d55792925a4bf9db322be8e4c9`.

The [freeze](https://github.com/camerontjs-dot/biotech-rag-assistant/blob/6f6e90b75f160370116a22c1c342231d9d14008d/research/evidence/qualifier-grounding-semantic-assessor-controls-v1/freeze.json), [terminal receipt](https://github.com/camerontjs-dot/biotech-rag-assistant/blob/6f6e90b75f160370116a22c1c342231d9d14008d/research/evidence/qualifier-grounding-semantic-assessor-controls-v1/TERMINAL.json), [checks](https://github.com/camerontjs-dot/biotech-rag-assistant/blob/6f6e90b75f160370116a22c1c342231d9d14008d/research/evidence/qualifier-grounding-semantic-assessor-controls-v1/receipts/), and [deviations](https://github.com/camerontjs-dot/biotech-rag-assistant/blob/6f6e90b75f160370116a22c1c342231d9d14008d/research/evidence/qualifier-grounding-semantic-assessor-controls-v1/deviations.json) preserve evidence separately from future semantic validity. [Dedicated hosted preparation checks](https://github.com/camerontjs-dot/biotech-rag-assistant/actions/runs/36874264286) passed on a physical runner. [Repository CI](https://github.com/camerontjs-dot/biotech-rag-assistant/actions/runs/36874264026) reports 298 inherited lint findings in each Python job, zero findings in the new preparation source; tests/compile/corpus smoke were skipped and static-demo parity passed. Append-only publication records preserve these observations without changing the frozen package.

## Security & Leak Prevention Checklist

- [x] Active pre-commit leak guard passed; no credentials or local machine paths added.
- [x] No .env, caches, private documents or protected payloads added.
- [x] Zero project model/provider, generation, adjudicator, assessor or reducer calls.
- [x] Wave B remains LOCKED; no TEST/PROSPECTIVE access, CAL, ADR-018 change, promotion, merge or release.

The next evidence-producing task is the separately authorized sealed case-author/A/B/reconciliation/apparatus-assurance sequence. This preparation establishes neither semantic-assessor validity nor independent human judgment.
